_readme: Demo dataset: real, dated repeat imagery (NASA/USGS/Planet) — genuine before/after pairs of the same site. Each item is uploaded through the normal API, so the AI observation and verification result are computed, never scripted. 'demo' items are deliberate integrity-check demonstrations.

items.description: Satellite monitoring of forest cover and land clearing along the Rio Machado corridor, Rondônia, Brazil.
items.credit: "Rondônia Deforestation (18 June 2014), Brazil" by O.V.E.R.V.I.E.W. (Landsat 8 / USGS data), CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
"Rondônia Deforestation (25 July 2016), Brazil" by O.V.E.R.V.I.E.W. (Landsat 8 / USGS data), CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons

items.description: Repeat satellite imagery of Columbia Glacier, Alaska, tracking its retreat.
items.credit: NASA Earth Observatory (Landsat 8 OLI), public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
NASA Earth Observatory (Landsat OLI), public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

items.description: Satellite record of the Aral Sea's shrinking water surface between 1989 and 2008.
